objective: Corregir la prueba de contrato Agent-Reach que fallo por confundir la version de runtime/CLI yt-dlp 2026.07.04 con la version normalizada del paquete Python 2026.7.4. No cambiar el runtime correcto. Crear una prueba de regresion que valide ambas representaciones en sus fuentes canonicas y repetir gate hasta PASS.

actions.content:
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
INFRA = ROOT / 'infra' / 'agent-reach'
WORKFLOW = ROOT / '.github' / 'workflows' / 'agent-reach-runtime-audit.yml'
VENDORED = ROOT / 'third_party' / 'agent-reach'


def read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def test_canonical_agent_reach_files_exist():
    required = [
        INFRA / 'Dockerfile',
        INFRA / 'README.md',
        INFRA / 'build.sh',
        INFRA / 'healthcheck.sh',
        INFRA / 'requirements.lock',
        INFRA / 'versions.lock',
        INFRA / 'yt-dlp.conf',
        WORKFLOW,
        VENDORED / 'pyproject.toml',
    ]
    missing = [str(path.relative_to(ROOT)) for path in required if not path.is_file()]
    assert not missing, f'Missing canonical Agent-Reach files: {missing}'


def test_versions_are_pinned_and_runtime_isolated():
    versions = read(INFRA / 'versions.lock')
    requirements = read(INFRA / 'requirements.lock')
    assert 'AGENT_REACH_VERSION=1.5.0' in versions
    assert 'DENO_VERSION=2.9.4' in versions
    # yt-dlp CLI/runtime preserves the date-style zero padding.
    assert 'YTDLP_VERSION=2026.07.04' in versions
    # Python package pins use the normalized PEP 440 representation.
    assert 'yt-dlp==2026.7.4' in requirements
    assert 'PIP_VERSION=26.1.2' in versions
    dockerfile = read(INFRA / 'Dockerfile')
    assert 'USER edarsa-agent-reach' in dockerfile
    assert 'VIRTUAL_ENV=/opt/edarsa/agent-reach/venv' in dockerfile
    assert '/root/.agent-reach' not in dockerfile
    assert 'ffmpeg' in dockerfile
    assert 'ffprobe' in dockerfile


def test_healthcheck_enforces_non_root_and_pinned_tools():
    health = read(INFRA / 'healthcheck.sh')
    assert '[ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]' in health
    for command in ('agent-reach', 'python', 'yt-dlp', 'deno', 'ffmpeg', 'ffprobe', 'curl'):
        assert f'require_command {command}' in health
    assert 'AGENT_REACH_HEALTHCHECK=PASS' in health


def test_build_and_ci_do_not_publish_or_deploy():
    build = read(INFRA / 'build.sh')
    workflow = read(WORKFLOW)
    assert 'docker push' not in build
    assert 'kubectl' not in build
    assert 'helm ' not in build
    assert 'IMAGE_PUSHED=0' in build
    assert 'DEPLOY_EXECUTED=0' in build
    assert 'contents: read' in workflow
    assert 'docker push' not in workflow
    assert 'kubectl' not in workflow
    assert 'helm ' not in workflow
    assert 'IMAGE_PUSHED=0' in workflow
    assert 'DEPLOY_EXECUTED=0' in workflow


def test_runtime_has_no_direct_backend_or_sql_contract():
    dockerfile = read(INFRA / 'Dockerfile')
    build = read(INFRA / 'build.sh')
    combined = dockerfile + '\n' + build
    assert 'backend/' not in combined
    assert 'sqlcmd' not in combined.lower()
    assert 'mongo' not in combined.lower()
